name: 2185-solodecode-llama31-8b-tp8
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, the ungated mirror of the gated `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct` and config.json-identical to it; ~16 GB of bf16 weights.
hardware: 8x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node. No router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: tp8, one tensor-parallel group over the eight cards of one node. No pipeline, data or expert parallelism.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, hidden 4096, intermediate 14336, 32 query heads over 8 KV heads, head dim 128, vocab 128256, rope_scaling llama3, bf16 unquantized, 8.03B parameters.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 15%, bounded at 300 requests with a 900 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: exactly 1024 prompt tokens and exactly 256 output tokens, no spread on either side, greedy (`temperature: 0.0`) and `ignore_eos: true` under `backend.extras.body`. Seed 42.
purpose: A single-user drafting assistant turning page-length prompts into short completions on an eight-GPU node, one request at a time.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only: a nested block is dropped by the parser, and the engine then runs
# without what this file declares.

model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 8
enable-torch-compile: true

# Must stay >= any `streams` value used: above it the engine does not compile that batch size.
torch-compile-max-bs: 8

attention-backend: flashinfer
disable-radix-cache: true
mem-fraction-static: 0.82
random-seed: 42
